text:
ravi: Heads-up — daily capacity/consumption pipeline failed on the v2 schema backfill this morning, it's stalling the GPU-hours projection job.

dan: What failed exactly? error log?

ravi: Error was a null in gpu_memory_gb for some pre-emptible records. Downstream join to instance_profiles assumes non-null.

maria: Ugh we've seen that before when the telemetry agent dropped fields on upgrade. Which topic/table?

ravi: kafka topic telemetry.usage.agg-v2 -> landing S3 path s3://redwood-telemetry/usage/agg-v2/2026-10-03/; Airflow dag gpu_consumption_ingest:v2 marks run as FAILED.

ops-bot: Dag gpu_consumption_ingest:v2 failed on task normalize_schema at 2026-10-03T08:12:17Z (see logs).

dan: Quick triage: either change normalization to coalesce(gpu_memory_gb, instance_profiles.default_memory) or drop records with missing gpu_type. Which is safer for forecast?

sarah: For forecasts we prefer bias toward inclusion (impute) rather than dropping — dropping skews utilization down. Use imputation with a small flag so the metric can exclude imputed if needed.

ravi: I'll patch normalizer to coalesce and add imputed_flag. Patch: ```UPDATE transform SET gpu_memory_gb = COALESCE(gpu_memory_gb, lookup(instance_type).memory_gb), imputed_flag = TRUE WHERE gpu_memory_gb IS NULL;```

maria: Also double-check partitioning — the backfill was slowed because files were tiny and we had many small parquet files. Consider changing producer to batch by hour or run a compaction after landing.

lee: Agree. Small file explosion was causing read amplification in the BQ load. For now I'll queue a compaction job: glue/compaction -> merge parquet into hourly objects.

dan: Can we also add a sanity check in the ingest DAG to fail fast when schema drift is detected and alert capacity planning? Today's failure delayed the throughput projection dashboard refresh.

sarah: +1 on alerting. We need an SLO: ingest lag < 1h and backfill time < 6h for 7 days window. If not, page on-call.

ops-bot: New alert rule proposal: telemetry.ingest.lag_v2 > 3600 -> PagerDuty #infra-oncall; telemetry.compaction.queue_length > 10 -> slack notification.

ravi: After the patch I re-ran backfill; it completed but bumped GPU-hours by ~2.7% on 2026-10-02 because missing memory imputed higher than default. Noted for forecasts.

maria: We should surface imputed fraction in the forecast dashboard — metric definitions need to include imputed_count and imputed_pct.

lee: Agreed. Proposal for metric defs (to store in metrics repo): ["date", "gpu_hours", "gpu_seconds", "active_gpu_count", "effective_utilization", "imputed_count", "imputed_pct", "producer_topic_lag_ms"]. Each as numeric; imputed_pct = imputed_count / total_records.

dan: Also add source_version tag to each daily row so we can compare v1 vs v2 differences in the dashboard.

sarah: For forecasting models. Please export a sample CSV with both v1 and v2 for the last 90 days so data-science can retrain. Also note holiday effects: last November spike correlated with marketing campaign.

ravi: I'll push the schema change: analytics.gpu_usage_v2(date STRING, gpu_hours FLOAT, gpu_seconds INT64, active_gpu_count INT64, effective_utilization FLOAT, imputed_count INT64, imputed_pct FLOAT, source_version STRING) and add partitioning by date.

maria: What about retention? Cost team wants 365 days raw telemetry for audit. We currently compact to 90d.

lee: We can keep raw logs in cold S3 (glacier-tier) for 365 days and maintain 90d in hot for dashboards. That matches cost constraints.

sarah: Also add a derived metric for projected_gpu_hours_next_7d using week-over-week smoothing. Define as: ```projected_gpu_hours_next_7d = avg(gpu_hours[-7:-1]) * seasonality_factor``` where seasonality_factor is weekly ratio. Include uncertainty band.

dan: Can we expose projection error in dashboard: MAE and last_retrain_date. Important for commit conversations with finance.

maria: I'll update the dashboard panels: ingest status, imputed_pct, gpu_hours trend, 7d projection with CI, and projection_error. Will tag panels with data source version.

ravi: Done. Pushed normalization patch and compaction job triggered. I'll monitor the next scheduled run and post results here.

ops-bot: Dag gpu_consumption_ingest:v2 succeeded at 2026-10-03T10:05:12Z (runtime 1h32m).

dan: Nice. Next steps: 1) Add schema drift unit tests in CI 2) Add imputation meta flag to metrics 3) Set alerting thresholds 4) Export 90d v1+v2 sample for DS.

sarah: I'll coordinate with finance for the cost impact note once projections stabilize.

maria: Thx team — good catch and quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
